# # Verify protobuf well-known type contract compliance across protobuf compiler, gRPC runtime, and googleapis

Your team maintains a gRPC-based microservice architecture that depends on
protobuf well-known types (Timestamp, Duration, FieldMask, Struct, Any). After
upgrading protobuf to v25.1 and gRPC to v1.60.0, some services report
serialization errors when exchanging messages containing well-known types.

The issue may stem from contract drift between how protobuf defines well-known
types, how the gRPC C++ core runtime handles their serialization, and how
googleapis common protos depend on specific well-known type behaviors.

Your task:

1. Find where protobuf defines the well-known types — locate the .proto files
   and the language-specific runtime implementations (particularly the JSON
   serialization for Timestamp, Duration, and Struct). Identify any v25.x
   changes to serialization behavior.
2. Find where the gRPC C++ core handles protobuf serialization — locate the
   protobuf serialization integration, message codec, and any well-known type
   special-casing in the gRPC runtime.
3. Find where googleapis common protos reference well-known types — locate
   the .proto files that import google/protobuf/\*.proto and identify any
   assumptions about serialization format or field presence.
4. Map the contract chain: protobuf definitions -> gRPC runtime serialization
   -> googleapis consumer expectations.

Write your analysis to /workspace/analysis/IMPACT_REPORT.md with:

- Well-known type definition locations (protobuf repo)
- gRPC serialization integration points
- googleapis dependencies on well-known type behavior
- Contract violations or drift points


Search only these repositories: github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1, github.com/sg-evals/grpc--v1.60.0, github.com/sg-evals/googleapis--common-protos-1_3_1

The analysis is complete. Here is the full impact report:

# Well-Known Type Contract Compliance Impact Report

## 1. Protobuf v25.1 — WKT Definition Locations

All five target WKTs are defined in [`src/google/protobuf/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/tree/src/google/protobuf):

| WKT | Proto file | Wire fields |
|-----|-----------|-------------|
| Timestamp | [`timestamp.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/timestamp.proto) | `int64 seconds=1`, `int32 nanos=2` |
| Duration | [`duration.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/duration.proto) | `int64 seconds=1`, `int32 nanos=2` |
| Struct/Value | [`struct.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/struct.proto) | `map<string,Value> fields=1`; oneof `kind` (fields 1–6) |
| Any | [`any.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/any.proto) | `string type_url=1`, `bytes value=2` |
| FieldMask | [`field_mask.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/field_mask.proto) | `repeated string paths=1` |

### JSON Serialization Engine (v25.x rewrite)

The JSON layer was substantially rewritten in v25.x. The key files:

- **Public API:** [`src/google/protobuf/json/json.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/json.h) — `MessageToJsonString()`, `JsonStringToMessage()`
- **Serializer:** [`json/internal/unparser.cc`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc) — contains all WKT-specific `Write*` functions
- **WKT classifier:** [`json/internal/descriptor_traits.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/descriptor_traits.h) — `ClassifyMessage()` dispatches on `google.protobuf.*` name
- **Time utilities:** [`util/time_util.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/util/time_util.h) — `TimeUtil::IsTimestampValid()`, `IsDurationValid()`

#### v25.1 Behavioral Changes to JSON Serialization

| WKT | Change | Code Location |
|-----|--------|---------------|
| **Duration** | **NEW strict sign check**: if `seconds != 0 && nanos != 0` and their signs differ, serialization now returns `InvalidArgumentError("nanos and seconds signs do not match")` | [`unparser.cc:667`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc?L667) |
| **Any** | Missing `value` field (with `type_url` present) now errors unless `allow_legacy_syntax` is set | [`unparser.cc:741`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc?L741) |
| **Value** | `NaN` and `Infinity` in `number_value` now hard-fail instead of serializing as strings | [`unparser.cc:510–520`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc?L510-L520) |
| **Timestamp** | Fractional seconds always normalized to 3/6/9 digits (or omitted); range validated hard | [`unparser.cc:579–640`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc?L579-L640) |
| **FieldMask** | Characters outside `[a-z0-9._]` / `_` (camelCase separator) reject without `allow_legacy_syntax` | [`unparser.cc:710–713`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/protobuf--v25.1/-/blob/src/google/protobuf/json/internal/unparser.cc?L710-L713) |

---

## 2. gRPC C++ v1.60.0 — Serialization Integration Points

**Two distinct serialization paths exist — they do not share WKT validation logic.**

### Application-Layer Path (message codec)

Defined in [`include/grpcpp/impl/proto_utils.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/grpc--v1.60.0/-/blob/include/grpcpp/impl/proto_utils.h):

- `GenericSerialize<ProtoBufferWriter, T>()` calls `msg.SerializeWithCachedSizesToArray()` (small messages) or `msg.SerializeToZeroCopyStream()` (larger).
- `GenericDeserialize<ProtoBufferReader, T>()` calls `msg->ParseFromZeroCopyStream()`.
- This is **binary wire-format only**. The gRPC core never calls `MessageToJsonString()` for transport. No v25.1 JSON WKT rules apply to binary gRPC calls.

The `SerializationTraits<T>` interface at [`include/grpcpp/impl/serialization_traits.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/grpc--v1.60.0/-/blob/include/grpcpp/impl/serialization_traits.h) is the extension point — any message type passing through gRPC must specialise it.

### Internal upb Layer (xDS / LB config)

gRPC uses its own upb-generated bindings for all internal config parsing. Generated WKT headers live in [`src/core/ext/upb-gen/google/protobuf/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/grpc--v1.60.0/-/tree/src/core/ext/upb-gen/google/protobuf):

- [`timestamp.upb.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/grpc--v1.60.0/-/blob/src/core/ext/upb-gen/google/protobuf/timestamp.upb.h) — `google_protobuf_Timestamp_parse()`, `_set_seconds()`, `_set_nanos()` — raw upb field access
- [`duration.upb.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/grpc--v1.60.0/-/blob/src/core/ext/upb-gen/google/protobuf/duration.upb.h), [`any.upb.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/grpc--v1.60.0/-/blob/src/core/ext/upb-gen/google/protobuf/any.upb.h), [`struct.upb.h`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/grpc--v1.60.0/-/blob/src/core/ext/upb-gen/google/protobuf/struct.upb.h)

The upb layer performs **zero validation** — field values are set/read via direct `_upb_Message_SetNonExtensionField` / `_upb_Message_GetNonExtensionField`. An invalid Duration (mixed signs) or an Any with no value can be constructed and transmitted over the wire without any error at the gRPC layer.

---

## 3. googleapis Common Protos v1.3.1 — WKT Dependencies

### High-Risk Consumers

| Proto | WKTs | Risk |
|-------|------|------|
| [`google/rpc/status.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/googleapis--common-protos-1_3_1/-/blob/google/rpc/status.proto) | `Any` in `details` | **CRITICAL** — error details propagation; Any must have `value` set |
| [`google/rpc/error_details.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/googleapis--common-protos-1_3_1/-/blob/google/rpc/error_details.proto) | `Duration` in `RetryInfo.retry_delay` | **HIGH** — inside Status.details Any; Duration sign rule |
| [`google/longrunning/operations.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/googleapis--common-protos-1_3_1/-/blob/google/longrunning/operations.proto) | `Any` in `metadata`, `response` | **HIGH** — LRO metadata/result are Any-typed |
| [`google/api/servicecontrol/v1/log_entry.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/googleapis--common-protos-1_3_1/-/blob/google/api/servicecontrol/v1/log_entry.proto) | Timestamp + Any + Struct | **HIGH** — log payloads; NaN/Infinity in Struct will fail |
| [`google/logging/v2/log_entry.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/googleapis--common-protos-1_3_1/-/blob/google/logging/v2/log_entry.proto) | Timestamp + Any + Struct | **HIGH** — same as above |
| [`google/api/servicemanagement/v1/resources.proto`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/googleapis--common-protos-1_3_1/-/blob/google/api/servicemanagement/v1/resources.proto) | Any + FieldMask + Struct + Timestamp | **HIGH** — hits all four major WKTs |

Timestamp and Duration are also used across ~15 additional protos (monitoring, bigtable, datastore, appengine, cloudbuild, storagetransfer, genomics).

---

## 4. Contract Chain

```
[protobuf v25.1]
  timestamp/duration/struct/any/field_mask .proto schemas
       ↓ binary wire format (unchanged)
       ↓ JSON format (new strict rules in v25.1):
           • Duration sign consistency
           • Any value presence
           • Value NaN/Infinity rejection
           • FieldMask char whitelist

[gRPC C++ v1.60.0]
  SerializationTraits → GenericSerialize/Deserialize
       ↓ binary transport only (no JSON rules applied)
  upb-gen WKT bindings
       ↓ raw field access, zero validation

[googleapis common-protos v1.3.1]
  Consumers via import, no inline validation logic
  Implicit contract: fields are "valid" per WKT spec
       NOW means v25.1 strict rules at JSON boundary
```

---

## 5. Contract Violations / Drift Points

**DRIFT-1 — Duration sign inconsistency (P0):** `google.rpc.RetryInfo.retry_delay`, monitoring time windows, appengine timeouts — any Duration with `sign(seconds) != sign(nanos)` now fails JSON serialization. Previously tolerated.

**DRIFT-2 — Any missing value (P0):** `google.rpc.Status.details`, `google.longrunning.Operation.metadata/response` — Any with only `type_url` set now errors on JSON serialization. Common in LRO metadata when the type is declared but not yet populated.

**DRIFT-3 — Struct NaN/Infinity (P1):** `google.logging.v2.LogEntry.json_payload`, `google.api.servicecontrol.v1.LogEntry.struct_payload`, `google.cloud.audit.AuditLog.service_data` — numeric payloads from floating-point computations may carry NaN.

**DRIFT-4 — upb layer has no JSON validation awareness (P1):** gRPC internal WKT fields (Duration in xDS health-check, Timestamp in LB stats) can be built with values that pass binary transport but fail v25.1 JSON serialization if any downstream component (logging, transcoding, admin API) calls `MessageToJsonString`.

**DRIFT-5 — FieldMask character validation (P2):** Update masks in servicemanagement protos with non-standard characters will now be rejected.

---

## Recommended Actions

| Priority | Action |
|----------|--------|
| P0 | Audit all Duration construction: enforce `sign(seconds) == sign(nanos)` |
| P0 | Audit all Any construction: ensure `value` bytes are populated whenever `type_url` is set |
| P1 | Add pre-serialization Struct/Value NaN+Infinity guards in log payload producers |
| P1 | Add application-level validation (`TimeUtil::IsTimestampValid`, `IsDurationValid`) before passing upb-constructed WKTs to JSON APIs |
| P2 | Validate FieldMask path strings against `[a-z][a-z0-9._]*` before serialization |

The full structured analysis has been written to the artifact above. The binary gRPC transport path is unaffected by the v25.1 changes; all serialization failures are at the **JSON boundary** — transcoding, logging, and any REST-facing gateway layer.
